comment: Upstream Pi packages the setup offers, exact-pinned like the mise manifest: `pi install npm:<name>@<version>`. Users get new versions only when a pin change lands on main; the mise-bump workflow proposes bumps. First-party packages still live in plugins/ workspaces.

packages.name: pi-subagents
packages.label: subagents
packages.description: Delegate tasks to subagents: chain them, run them in parallel, let them ask you questions mid-run. By nicobailon.
packages.nextAction: Ask Pi to delegate a task to a subagent.

packages.name: pi-web-access
packages.label: web-access
packages.description: web_search and fetch_content tools for pages, PDFs, and GitHub repos. By nicobailon.
packages.nextAction: Ask Pi to search the web.

packages.name: pi-rewind-hook
packages.label: rewind
packages.description: Records file checkpoints as you work; branch to an earlier message and it restores your files to match. By nicobailon.
packages.nextAction: Branch to an earlier Pi message to see files rewind.

packages.name: pi-claude-bridge
packages.label: claude-bridge
packages.description: Use Claude models inside Pi through your Claude subscription. By elidickinson.
packages.nextAction: Run /model in Pi and pick a Claude model.
